en-US.title: A trip to China with just Harry!! Taking on the challenge of getting the perfect shot at Baekbeom...
en-US.description:
To mark the 100th anniversary of the establishment of the Provisional Government, Harry and I went on a 5-night, 6-day trip to China to trace the footsteps of the Provisional Government!

It would have been great to go with the Utsso members, but this was the first time we set off on a separate trip like this haha. It was just the two of us, Harry and me, having a cozy time together haha.

During these 5 nights and 6 days, we traveled a long distance starting from Shanghai, visiting Jiaxing, Hangzhou, and Chongqing, and we returned having seen and experienced so much.

Among those experiences, we planned content where we would take the "photo of a lifetime" on the stairs of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea's Yeonhwa Branch Office in Chongqing. For this video, we even got matching vintage-style suits, and we took some truly amazing photos of a lifetime!!

#100thAnniversaryOfTheEstablishmentOfTheProvisionalGovernmentOfTheRepublicOfKorea #Baekbeom'sStairs
